pairs.why: The two are nearly identical; B's cover is held down by simple brass rivets, which reads a little cleaner and more like the chunky real props than A's fiddly little hook clasps.
This is the q048 pair with the sides swapped, so for consistency the rivet version (A) gets the slight edge over the hook-clasp version for the same reason.
Both are smooth and soft-lit like the real cards, but B's bigger, chunkier crossed logs and neater stone ring read a little more like a built game prop than A's small logs sunk into the rocks.
Both share the same smooth finish, warm light and build, and the only differences are small changes in log and flame placement that don't move either closer to the real cards.
B's tripod legs show carved wood grain and its knot is fussier, which is the too-textured look the lessons rejected; A's smoother legs match the gently soft real cards.
A has the grainier, more textured tripod legs, while B keeps the smoother surfaces of the real pump and buoy.
B again has the visibly grained, more textured legs; A's smooth wood matches the real cards' finish.
A is the textured-grain version; B is smoother with chunky, clean logs, closer to the real cards' finish.
